info.text:
Your car gets repossessed. You can still owe thousands. The average was $11,340.
After a default, in many states a lender can take the car without a court order. It's usually sold at auction, often for less than you owe.
Example: owe $20,000, car sells for $12,000, $1,500 in fees = $9,500 deficiency balance, and no car.
CFPB: the average deficiency balance was $11,340 in Dec 2022. A repo can stay on your credit report up to 7 years. Cox Automotive estimated about 1.73M repos in 2024.
Sources: CFPB; Cox Automotive.
News and education, not financial advice.
